purpose: Selection policy for the private regulatory deadline discovery and review process. This policy keeps the broad authority catalogue separate from source-checked deadline intake.

catalogue.description: The global authority catalogue is a discovery perimeter. Catalogue membership does not imply a source is scanned or that it can create a deadline record.

activeIntake.description: Primary authorities with a configured publication transport. Their output may create private review candidates only; it never confirms a deadline or authorises public publication.
